claim: There are exactly 13 S6-isomorphism classes of maximum intersecting 3-families on [6].

correctness_evidence.method: fresh exhaustive enumeration of one-from-each-complement-pair transversals and canonicalization under all 720 permutations

decisive_prior_art.title: A hierarchy of maximal intersecting triple systems
decisive_prior_art.location: published page 601, Proposition 1.6 and preceding paragraph
decisive_prior_art.coverage: Explicitly derives the 2^10 six-vertex maximal intersecting triple systems and states there are 13 pairwise non-isomorphic classes.

repair: Narrowing to representatives, stabilizers, orbit sizes, or shifting flags leaves only routine certificate-level refinements of the prior 13-type classification and does not restore sufficient scientific value.
